title: Copilot — Billing and Cost
description: AI credit and premium request billing metrics from VictoriaMetrics.

options.content:
## Copilot Billing and Cost

This dashboard tracks GitHub Copilot AI credit and premium request consumption. Data is sourced from the billing APIs collected by the exact-diff exporter and written to VictoriaMetrics daily.

**Key concepts**
- **AI Credits** — the primary billing metric for Copilot premium model usage. 1 AI Credit = $0.01 USD.
- **Premium Requests** — the previous billing metric, shown here for historical comparison.
- **Net Amount** — the amount after enterprise discounts. This is the figure on your GitHub invoice.
- **Gross Amount** — the amount before any discounts.
- **Usage Summary** — the broader enterprise billing view across all GitHub products.

**Sections:** AI Credit Summary | AI Credit Trends | AI Credit by Model | Premium Request Summary | Usage Summary

Use the **Enterprise** dropdown to select your enterprise. Use the time picker to change the billing window.

panels.title: Total AI Credit Net Amount (USD)
panels.description: Total net spend in USD for AI credits after enterprise discounts. This is the figure that appears on your GitHub invoice for premium model usage. Source: github_copilot_billing_ai_credit_total_net_amount.

panels.title: Total AI Credit Gross Amount (USD)
panels.description: Total gross spend in USD before enterprise discounts. Compare to net amount to understand the value of negotiated discounts. Source: github_copilot_billing_ai_credit_total_gross_amount.

panels.title: Total AI Credit Discount (USD)
panels.description: Total discount received on AI credits in the selected window. Source: github_copilot_billing_ai_credit_total_discount_amount.

panels.title: Total AI Credits Consumed
panels.description: Total quantity of AI credits consumed after discounts in the selected window. Source: github_copilot_billing_ai_credit_total_net_quantity.

panels.title: Daily AI Credit Net Amount Over Time (USD)
panels.description: Daily net AI credit spend in USD. Spikes indicate days with heavy premium model usage. Use this to identify unusually expensive days. Source: github_copilot_billing_ai_credit_total_net_amount.

panels.title: Daily AI Credits Consumed Over Time
panels.description: Daily net AI credit quantity consumed. Use alongside the spend chart to confirm quantity and spend are moving proportionally. Source: github_copilot_billing_ai_credit_total_net_quantity.

panels.title: AI Credit Net Amount by Model (USD)
panels.description: Total net AI credit spend in USD by model for the selected window. Identifies primary cost-driving models. Source: github_copilot_billing_ai_credit_net_amount grouped by model.

panels.title: AI Credit Net Quantity by Model
panels.description: Total net AI credits consumed per model. Use alongside the spend chart to verify quantity and spend are proportional across models. Source: github_copilot_billing_ai_credit_net_quantity grouped by model.

panels.title: Premium Request Net Amount (USD)
panels.description: Total net spend for premium requests after discounts. Premium requests are the previous billing metric being phased out in favour of AI credits. Source: github_copilot_billing_premium_request_total_net_amount.

panels.title: Premium Requests Consumed
panels.description: Total net quantity of premium requests consumed in the selected window. Source: github_copilot_billing_premium_request_total_net_quantity.

panels.title: Premium Request Spend Over Time
panels.description: Daily net premium request spend trend. Compare to the AI credit trend to understand the transition between billing models over time. Source: github_copilot_billing_premium_request_total_net_amount.

panels.title: Usage Summary Net Amount (USD)
panels.description: Total net spend across all GitHub products in the enterprise billing usage summary. This is the broadest billing view and includes all SKUs, not just Copilot. Source: github_billing_usage_summary_total_net_amount.

panels.title: Usage Summary Net Amount Over Time
panels.description: Daily net spend from the enterprise usage summary across all GitHub products. Use this as the top-level cost view to understand total GitHub spend versus Copilot-specific spend. Source: github_billing_usage_summary_total_net_amount.
